Flow: router (`app/api/v1/endpoints/ats_matching.py`) -> `ATSMatchingService` (`services/ats_matching_service.py`) -> `ATSMatchingRepository` (`repositories/ats_matching_repo.py`) -> PostgreSQL (`job_descriptions`, `resume_jd_matches`).

## Rules
1. **Guest & Authenticated Support:** `POST /v1/match/ats-scan` uses `get_current_user_optional` so both anonymous visitors and authenticated candidates can run ATS scans. Persist `candidate_identity_id` only when authenticated.
2. **Deterministic Scoring:** Compatibility scores, missing hard skills, and STAR impact checks must return strongly typed `ATSScanResponse` DTOs.

## Known Traps
- **Router Prefix:** Mounted with `APIRouter(prefix="/match")` under `/v1`, so the full runtime URL is `POST /v1/match/ats-scan`.
